ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows quadrilateral WXYZ, shaped like a kite; diagonal WY is horizontal, XZ is vertical, and they intersect at point P. The figure marks PY = 24, PZ = 8, and asks to find side ZY. Reasoning: Because WXYZ is kite, one diagonal of a kite is perpendicular to the other diagonal, so WY ⟂ XZ, and triangle PYZ is a right triangle at P. Thus ZY is the hypotenuse of right triangle PYZ. By the Pythagorean theorem: ZY = sqrt(PY^2 + PZ^2) = sqrt(24^2 + 8^2) = sqrt(576 + 64) = sqrt(640) = 8sqrt(10).
